title: Add the Higgsfield MCP in ChatGPT to use Seedance 2.5 for UGC ad generation
content:
Add the Higgsfield MCP in ChatGPT to use Seedance 2.5 for UGC ad generation  
Paste your product link into ChatGPT so it can generate hooks and scripts for the ad  
Use Higgsfield MCP to select a creator and generate the UGC-style ad from the script
